_meta.role: Large Language Model Inference System Engineer Graduate (Applied Machine Learning) - 2027 Start

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Builds and profiles GPU inference systems from the kernel up: custom CUDA C++ kernels with memory coalescing achieved a 35% speedup over an uncoalesced baseline, and 8-bit quantization on a 1.1B parameter language model cut GPU memory footprint by roughly 55% with under 1% accuracy loss. Also runs distributed workloads with MPI on SLURM-managed clusters, characterizing load balancing and scaling behavior up to 30x speedup.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86.
Developed a custom image-stitching pipeline for high-resolution generation using bit manipulation and averaging, achieving a PSNR of 65 compared to a homography-based stitching baseline.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free document understanding transformer) using PyTorch and HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder for structured field extraction.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights/biases, and preallocated global buffers to eliminate per-layer allocation overhead.
Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript), a ~35% speedup over naive GPU with identical classification accuracy.
Achieved 1.5-2x speedup in convolution operations through efficient global memory utilization.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; under 1% accuracy degradation with a +0.09 perplexity increase, near-lossless compression.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Implemented distributed dendrite computations across MPI workers with synchronous soma updates on a SLURM-managed cluster; achieved up to 10.49x speedup with 12 slave processes.
Characterized scaling behavior across dendrite counts and compartment depths; identified load imbalance effects showing up to 65% performance degradation under uneven work distribution.

projects.name: Parallel Ray Tracer with MPI Task Scheduling
bullets: Implemented and benchmarked four parallel work distribution strategies (static strip/block/cyclic, dynamic task queue) for rendering 5000x5000 pixel scenes using MPI.
Achieved up to 30x speedup with static strip partitioning (55 processes); demonstrated dynamic task queue outperformed all static methods under unpredictable workloads.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, and weight tying.
Built a TikToken-based tokenizer wrapper and custom training loop with early stopping and perplexity evaluation.
